# harness_platform_idp_scorecard (Resource)

Resource for creating IDP scorecards.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harness_platform_idp_scorecard_check" "readme" {
  identifier        = "readme_exists"
  name              = "README exists"
  description       = "Ensure the repository has a README file"
  rule_strategy     = "ALL_OF"
  default_behaviour = "FAIL"

  rules {
    data_source_identifier = "github"
    data_point_identifier  = "isFileExists"
    operator               = "=="
    value                  = "true"

    input_values {
      key   = "filePath"
      value = "README.md"
    }
  }
}

resource "harness_platform_idp_scorecard" "gold" {
  identifier         = "gold_standard"
  name               = "Gold Standard"
  description        = "Baseline production quality scorecard"
  published          = true
  weightage_strategy = "EQUAL_WEIGHTS"

  filter {
    kind = "component"
    type = "service"
  }

  checks {
    identifier = harness_platform_idp_scorecard_check.readme.identifier
    custom     = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `checks` (Block Set) Checks included in the scorecard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--checks))
- `filter` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Filters that select catalog entities evaluated by the scorecard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `identifier` (String) Unique identifier of the resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the scorecard is published.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the resource.
- `on_demand` (Boolean) Whether the scorecard is evaluated on demand.
- `tier_group_identifier` (String) Identifier of the tier group used to classify scores.
- `weightage_strategy` (String) Weightage strategy for checks. Valid values are EQUAL_WEIGHTS and CUSTOM.

### Read-Only

- `checks_missing` (List of String) Identifiers of checks referenced by the scorecard that are missing.
- `components` (Number) Number of components evaluated by the scorecard.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `percentage` (Number) Overall scorecard percentage.
- `tier_analytics` (List of Object) Component distribution across scorecard tiers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tier_analytics))

<a id="nestedblock--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `checks`

Required:

- `custom` (Boolean) Whether the referenced check is custom.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the check.

Optional:

- `weightage` (Number) Weightage of the check when using CUSTOM.

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the check.
- `name` (String) Name of the check.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `kind` (String) Catalog entity kind to evaluate.

Optional:

- `lifecycle` (List of String) Entity lifecycle stages to include.
- `owners` (List of String) Entity owners to include.
- `scopes` (List of String) Evaluation scopes (for example ACCOUNT, ORGANIZATION, or PROJECT).
- `tags` (List of String) Entity tags to include.
- `type` (String) Catalog entity type to evaluate.

<a id="nestedatt--tier_analytics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tier_analytics`

Read-Only:

- `component_count` (Number) Number of components in the tier.
- `max_score` (Number) Maximum score for the tier.
- `min_score` (Number) Minimum score for the tier.
- `percentage` (Number) Percentage of components in the tier.
- `tier_colour` (String) Colour of the tier.
- `tier_name` (String) Name of the tier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an IDP scorecard
terraform import harness_platform_idp_scorecard.example <scorecard_id>
```
